predictive_services_discussion: Breezy west-southwest winds with gusts of 35–45 mph and RH of 5–20% will create elevated fire conditions across the Inland Northwest, northern Rockies, and northern Great Basin. Locally critical conditions are possible from northeast California and northwest Nevada into southeast Oregon and southwest Idaho. Scattered mixed wet/dry thunderstorms are expected across western Montana, central/eastern Idaho, and the central Rockies, with drier storms possible in northeast Washington and north Idaho. Isolated mixed wet/dry thunderstorms will also extend from the eastern Sierra through the Great Basin to the West Slope, while wetter storms remain more numerous in Colorado and New Mexico east of the Divide, and the western High Plains. Thunderstorms are expected from south Texas to the Southeast ahead of a slow-moving cold front, with thunderstorm activity increasing into the Mid-Atlantic and portions of the Northeast. Dry, seasonable weather will prevail across the Midwest and Great Lakes.
